The `matrix_re` regex omits `attn\.c_proj\.weight`, so `h.<i>.attn.c_proj.weight` (12 tensors) is never cast to bfloat16, leaving only 36 bfloat16 tensors instead of the required 48 (violates Required result #1). The self-check `assert ... == 36` masks this bug instead of catching it, contradicting the spec's requirement that exactly 48 tensors be bfloat16.
